headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 28, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners fell to the Texas Rangers in a 7-3 loss, with Joc Pederson leading the offense with two home runs and four RBIs. Kumar Rocker earned the win for the Rangers, pitching 6.2 innings with seven strikeouts and two earned runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Beck Way (Kansas City Royals) who was placed on the 15-day injured list due to low back spasms/tightness. Other notable injuries include Cole Sands (Minnesota Twins) with a right elbow strain, Kerry Carpenter (Detroit Tigers) with left foot plantar fasciitis, and Cody Bellinger (New York Yankees) with a left hamstring strain.

The Pittsburgh Pirates made a notable trade, acquiring Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles for cash. Additionally, the Athletics signed Nu'u Contrades, and the St. Louis Cardinals traded Scott Blewett to the Athletics for cash.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall to Rangers in 7-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dropped a 7-3 decision to the Texas Rangers, with Joc Pederson leading the offense with two home runs and four RBIs. Kumar Rocker earned the win for the Rangers, pitching 6.2 innings with seven strikeouts and two earned runs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Tigers 8-5**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured an 8-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers in their matchup. Coby Mayo led the Orioles' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Diamondbacks in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Arizona Diamondbacks 3-2 in a closely contested matchup. Max Kepler led the Diamondbacks' offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs, while Merrill Kelly pitched 5.2 strong innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall Short in Miami**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dropped a 7-8 decision to the Miami Marlins, marking their latest loss. Heriberto Hernández led the Phillies' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge Reds in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the Cincinnati Reds, with multiple players contributing to the outcome. José Ramírez and Kyle Manzardo were among the Guardians' impact hitters, while Tyler Stephenson and Elly De La Cruz had notable performances for the Reds.

top_news.title: **Mets Shut Down Braves in Thrilling Tiebreaker**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 0-0 victory over the Atlanta Braves, claiming the win in a game that ended in a scoreless tie.

top_news.title: **Royals RHP Beck Way Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals right-hander Beck Way has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to low back spasms/tightness.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Rodríguez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles, who received cash in return.
